routing_result.work: Design the technology and architecture: the technology and architecture positions for the whole of a software project (its stack, its system shape and the standards every slice follows) are set once, written down, and can evolve later; nothing blocks on them. Part of a harness that takes a software product from its spec to its design before AI agents build it.

unmatched_domains.name: software delivery (the field of building software, here its design stage: setting a project's technology and architecture)
unmatched_domains.why: The product serves people who build software, and the job is to set the technology and system shape a software project is built on. None of the ten shelves (analytics, collaboration, content management, ecommerce, experience, marketing, notifications, payments, personalization, user management) has a trigger about building software or designing its architecture; each is about what an end product does for its own users. The technology and architecture shelves of memory are condition-matched learnings used inside a design, not domain shelves, so they are no home for the capability itself.

routing_result.why: No domain shelf lists the work of designing a software project's technology and architecture. Recorded as unmatched for the nothing-fits path.
